idea-plugin.name: MongoJS Prettier Format
idea-plugin.description:
Formats MongoDB / MongoJS Console code in DataGrip using a bundled QuickJS sidecar and Prettier Standalone.
No Node.js, npm, JetBrains JavaScript plugin, or JetBrains Prettier plugin is required at runtime.

Features

  • Reformat Code / Ctrl+Alt+L on MongoJS consoles and files
  • Whole-document formatting
  • Selection / range formatting via Prettier
  • Keeps the original document unchanged when formatting fails
